audience: online sellers who ship orders from several sales channels with Ordoro

useCases.title: See the fulfillment backlog
useCases.text: The AI counts orders per status (awaiting fulfillment, shipped, cancelled, dropship requested) and lists the orders still waiting, filtered by warehouse, SKU or tag.

useCases.title: Find an order and its shipment tracking
useCases.text: The AI finds an order by number or search and reads its lines, address, carrier, tracking number and URL, ship date and estimated delivery.

useCases.title: Find products with low or oversold stock
useCases.text: The AI lists products filtered by low inventory or oversold, reads on hand, available and committed totals, and opens one to see stock per warehouse.

useCases.title: Review purchase orders to suppliers
useCases.text: The AI lists purchase orders by status (unsent, sent, partial, received, cancelled), SKU or tag and reads the lines, expected delivery and received quantities.

useCases.title: Review return orders (RMAs)
useCases.text: The AI lists return orders with status, original order, lines and return label info, and opens the original order if you need its details.

useCases.title: Add or remove order tags, or add internal comments
useCases.text: The AI applies or removes an existing tag on an order, for example to put it on hold, or adds an internal comment the team sees in Ordoro.
